sources.title: Phi4 Multimodal - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Phi4 Multimodal Phi4 Multimodal is a multimodal model capable of text, image, and speech and audio inputs or any combination of these. It features a mixture of LoRA adapters for handling different inputs, and each input is routed to the appropriate encoder.
